top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation, it was determined that the staff was aware of a child receiving medical attention after sustaining an injury while in care, but did not report to Child Care Licensing within two days of becoming notified.

top_violation_types.title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A cleaning bottle was not labeled in a classroom with children present.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employee records evaluated was unavailable for review.     One out of four employee records evaluated was incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: Illness Preventing Care - Symptoms of Possible Severe Illness (26 TAC §746.3601(3)(E))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During an investigation it was found that a child was not sent home when the child had symptoms of a possible severe illness. There was a concern for the child's breathing and the child was not sent home.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The ground is splitting open and causing a tripping hazard at the entrance to the playground.       Photos taken

top_violation_types.title: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries (26 TAC §746.307(c))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation is not notifying parents of less serious injuries.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Products- Review list and Remove unsafe products (26 TAC §746.4135(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A boppy pillow recalled 9/23/21 was observed to be in the infant room and in use by an infant in care.
